spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (अभ्रति)
To go.

n. (-भ्रं)
1 The sky or atmosphere.
2 A cloud.
3

Gold.
4

Talc.
E.
अभ्र to go, or अप् water, and भृ to have, क aff.

m. (-हः)
Wind.
mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Cloud-touching, cloud-sweeping.
E.
अभ्र a cloud, लिह to lick, खश aff.

n. (-कं)
The mineral substance called talc.
E.
अभ्र the same, and कन् aff.

m. (-षः)
Air, wind.
E.
अभ्र the sky, कष to plough, and खच् aff.

m. (-चः)
A name of RĀHU, the descending node personified.
E.
अभ्र the sky, and पिशाच a goblin; from the mischief he does to the moon, as the cause of its eclipse.

m. (-कः)
See the preceding.
E.
कन् added to the former.

m. (-ष्पः)
A kind of tree or cane. See वेतस.
E.
अभ्र a cloud and पुष्प a flower; flowering in the cloudy or rainy season.
n. (-ष्पं)
Water.
E.
as before; put forth as a flower from the clouds.

m. (-मः)
Steadiness, composure.
mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Steady, clear, not blundering.
E.
अ neg. भ्रम confusion.

m. (-ङ्गः)
INDRA'S elephant.
E.
अभ्र a cloud, and मातङ्ग an elephant. The cloud-elephant, or that of the cloud-compelling king.

f. (-ला)
A line or succession of clouds.
E.
अभ्र, and माला a garland.

f. (-मुः)
The female elephant of the east.
E.
अ neg. भ्रम to wander, and उ aff.

m. (-यः)
The male elephant of the east, also INDRA'S elephant.
E.
अभ्रमु, and प्रिय beloved.

m. (-भः)
See the preceding.
E.
अभ्रमु, and वल्लभ beloved.

n. (-हं)
The lapis lazuli.
E.
अभ्र a cloud, रोह what mounts.

mf. (-कः-का)
Brotherless.
E.
अ neg. भ्रातृ a brother, कन aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Clear, composed, unperplexed, not mistaken or in error.
E.
अ neg. भ्रान्त misled.

f. (-न्तिः)
Absence of perplexity or error.
E.
अ neg. भ्रान्ति error.

m. (-शः)
Fall of rain.
E.
अभ्र cloud, अवकाश occasion.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Exposed to the rain.
E.
अभावकाश and ठक् aff.

f. (-भ्रिः)
A wooden scraper or shovel for cleaning a boat.
E.
अभ्र to go, and इन् affix, also अभ्री.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Belonging to or produced from clouds.
E.
अभ्र a cloud, and इय affix, or technically घ.

m. (-षः)
Fitness, propriety.
E.
अ neg. and भ्रेष impropriety.

n. (-त्थं)
INDRA'S thunder-bolt.
E.
अभ्र a cloud, उत् before स्था to stand, to rise up, क aff.
